sample.exports: 1280px JPEG working copies; embedded source metadata removed; neutral filenames

finalRun.reviewer: independent assistant visual review; not Jamie approval
caveats: Truck called stopped/roadside stop despite motion not established by the still photograph.
Exact noon and chronology inferred from appearance.
Water called still despite visible ripples.
Lily described as having no depth despite visible subject/background separation; compositional judgment overstated.
Final notebook adds six relative photo links that do not resolve beside the notebook.

limitations: Six selected outdoor photographs are not representative of the library or a blind photographic-quality benchmark.
Custom brief and test-only 6144-output-token cap; ordinary prompt, People metadata and production output defaults were not tested.
PhotoKit helper and one-record osxphotos probe timed out; read-only per-asset catalog lookup plus local original files were used. Whole-library count/digest freshness was not established.
Two rejected requests reported no usage or cost; do not count their missing usage as zero.
Comparative cost savings, general reliability, checkpoint identity and explicit reasoning controls remain unmeasured.
